obligor_aliases: Catholic Health System Inc Western NY

moodys.citation_text: Late 2022 Buffalo News: '$138M operating loss, gets credit rating downgraded' — Moody's took CHS Buffalo to Caa1 in late 2022. Subsequent 2024 upgrade was from Caa1 to B3.

rating_actions_in_window.action_detail: Caa1 affirmed; outlook revised to positive
rating_actions_in_window.rationale: Anticipated FEMA grants, recurring operating improvement
rating_actions_in_window.citation_text: Dec 2023 Buffalo News: 'amid financial turnaround, Catholic Health gets credit rating upgrade from Moody's'.

rating_actions_in_window.action_detail: Caa1 -> B3 (1 notch upgrade); outlook stable (originally positive)
rating_actions_in_window.rationale: Recent projected liquidity growth from anticipated receipt of sizable, recently approved FEMA grants; substantial and recurring improvement in operating performance; new Catholic Health Lockport Memorial Hospital opened; positive volume impact.
rating_actions_in_window.citation_text: Oct 2024 Buffalo News: 'Once financially ailing, Catholic Health now seeing substantial improvement, Moody's says'. Becker's: 'Moody's upgraded Catholic Health System's rating from Caa1 to B3'.

moodys.citation_text: Oct 2024 B3 in effect at window end. (Subsequent 2025 upgrade to B2 occurred AFTER window end per chsbuffalo.org blog.)

outcome_class_rationale: Single-notch UPGRADE within window (Caa1 -> B3 in Oct 2024). Deep sub-IG fallen-angel showing turnaround. Liquidity strongly dependent on one-time FEMA grants. Operating performance recurring improvement. NOTE: At window-start Caa1 already qualified as DEFAULT-tier per outcome taxonomy (Caa1 is below Ba3 floor for DEFAULT class). The 1-notch upgrade is improvement within distressed tier.
